title: How Building with AI Can Double the Throughput of Your Engineering Team — Brian Scanlan, Intercom
talk_summary: Brian Scanlan describes Intercom's '2x' program: standardize on Claude Code as a platform, encode Intercom-specific engineering knowledge into skills/plugins/hooks, and drive adoption through leadership and measurement. They report doubling PR throughput in under a year, with the bottleneck shifting to code review and early work on backtested auto-approval and session-transcript feedback loops.

takeaways.what_they_do: They encode engineering knowledge as small, durable, testable skills and use historical code/incidents to backtest whether each skill works at high quality.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we spend our time focusing on small, high-quality, durable, testable skills that do the job extremely well

takeaways.what_they_do: They log skill invocations and pull all agent session transcripts into S3 for data mining, reporting, and checking whether skills are effective.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we also pull in all session transcripts into S3 for data mining, writing reports

takeaways.what_they_do: They calibrate automatic code approval using backtesting, historical data, and human-labeled outputs, then shape PRs toward safe/simple changes that can be auto-approved.
takeaways.evidence_quote: using backtesting and previous data and then getting humans to kind of label the outputs
takeaways.numbers: 17.6% auto-approval rate; doubled PR throughput in under a year; code review became the bottleneck

takeaways.technique: Give agents problems, not prescribed tasks
takeaways.what_they_do: They move from telling agents exactly which skill to run toward describing the problem and letting the agent select the right skills and steps.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you want to give problems agents not tasks

takeaways.what_they_do: They push internal Claude plugins to everyone's laptops from a central mechanism rather than relying on per-user installs and updates.
takeaways.evidence_quote: push out our internal Cloud plugins to everyone's laptops

takeaways.what_they_do: They built a skill that fixes flaky specs through a feedback loop, with lookup tables and progressive disclosure, rather than hand-authoring every step.
takeaways.evidence_quote: a skill I built which like it just it fixes flaky specs
